solid #a1eaff8a;border-radius:22px;background:radial-gradient(#223d7bb0,#101b3e);min-height:220px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}.rail-track{margin-top:24px;min-height:130px;display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;padding:15px;overflow-x:auto}.rail-engine{font-size:54px;filter:drop-shadow(0 .highlight{background:#9bdfeb44;border-radius:8px}.reader-task{margin-top:18px}.reader-task>strong{font-size:23px}.mech-choice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;margin-top:14px}.mech-choice,.reason-panel{padding:18px @media (max-width:700px){.mech-intro{gap:9px}.mech-card{width:110px;min-width:96px}.mech-card img{height:85px}.mech-narration strong,.mech-narration b{font-size:18px}.mech-narration span{font-size:13px}.crystal{min-width:27%;height:110px}.crystal span{font-size:32px}.crystal strong{font-size:28px}.beam-arena{height:285px}.laser-base{width:110px}.laser-base img{width:108px}.cargo-bin{min-height:100px}.cargo-bin b{font-size:13px}.cargo-bin small{font-size:11px}.mech-choice-grid,.reason-options{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mech-choice,.reason-panel{min-height:50px}.drone-map{height:360px}.hoverdrone,.hoverdrone img{width:80px;height:72px}.wild-target{width:75px;height:75px}.dpad{min-width:48px;min-height:48px}.interview-pick img{height:86px}.interview-pick{font-size:13px}.rail-track{min-height:105px}.mech-tile{font-size:15px;padding:8px 10px}.flight-area{height:300px}.pilot-ship{width:90px}.star-layer .flight-star{width:54px;height:54px;font-size:33px}}
/* First-grade touch usability: put the actual activity before teacher side notes. */
@media(max-width:700px){
 .layout{display:flex;flex-direction:column}.mainpane{order:1}.side{order:2}
 .hero{min-height:190px}.hero-body{min-height:180px;padding:18px 20px}
 .hero h1{font-size:30px;margin:6px 0 7px;letter-spacing:-.8px}.hero p{font-size:13px}
 .tags{margin-top:10px}.tag{font-size:10px;padding:5px 9px}
 .zig{padding:12px}.zig img{width:62px;height:62px}
 .topbar{padding:10px}.navbits{gap:5px}
 .zone-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.mission-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* Far Horizon-inspired cinematic layout v2: real interactive DOM objects over authored environments. */
:root{--world-scene:none;--world-accent:#6be9f6;--world-halo:rgba(63,198,255,.35)}
.shell{max-width:1460px;padding:12px 20px 28px}
.topbar{border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(95deg,rgba(5,17,41,.95),rgba(18,28,72,.89));border:1px solid #71dfff55;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #b2faff22,0 12px 28px #0006;padding:10px 16px}
.topbtn{border-radius:12px}.topbtn.quiet{background:#132852b9}.brand span{font-size:clamp(17px,1.8vw,23px)}
.brand small{letter-spacing:1px;color:#87d8eb;font-size:10px}
.hero{border-radius:23px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #aff7ff30,0 22px 55px #020715ba;margin-top:12px}
.hero::before{animation:heroFloat 24s ease-in-out infinite alternate;transform-origin:center}
@keyframes heroFloat{from{transform:scale(1.03) translate3d(-.7%,0,0)}to{transform:scale(1.10) translate3d(1.6%,-.9%,0)}}
.hero::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#050e27ed 0%,#091838b8 40%,#05112d0a 100%)}
.zone-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:17px}
.zone-card{min-height:238px;border:1px solid #93e9fc99;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #cbfbff26,0 18px 31px #020720af;isolation:isolate}
.zone-card::before{transition:transform .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),filter .5s;filter:saturate(1.19) contrast(1.07)}
.zone-card:hover::before{transform:scale(1.09)}
.zone-card::after{background:linear-gradient(0deg,#050d25f6,#091c3bc4 31%,transparent 79%)}
.zone-card h3{font-size:clamp(21px,2.3vw,27px);line-height:1.08;text-shadow:0 2px 12px #000}
.zone-card p{font-size:12px;color:#d5f4fd;line-height:1.35}
.zone-card .status{margin-top:8px;font-size:11px}
.zone-card.finale{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:225px}
.zone-n{border-color:#8df0ff77;background:#061936dc;letter-spacing:.4px;font-size:11px}
.zone-card.locked{opacity:.79;filter:grayscale(.24)}
.mission-row{gap:14px}.mission{min-height:158px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0c2a50d9,#1b315eab);border:1px solid #7fe2ff80}
.mission:hover{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#123c69f2,#234a83ed);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #8ce8ff77,0 20px 30px #0008}
.mission b{font-size:22px}.mission small{line-height:1.35;font-size:13px;max-width:40ch}
.map-foot{background:#071936dc;border-color:#5dbfdf60;line-height:1.45}
/* During play, keep one single visual scene. Remove the previous worksheet margins. */
body:has(.immersive-scene) .hero,body:has(.immersive-scene) .side,body:has(.immersive-scene) #voiceState,body:has(.immersive-scene) footer{display:none!important}
body:has(.immersive-scene) .layout{display:block;margin-top:14px}
body:has(.immersive-scene) .mainpane{width:100%}
body:has(.immersive-scene) .topbar{margin-bottom:5px}
body:has(.zone-grid) .side,body:has(.scene-panel) .side{display:none!important}
body:has(.zone-grid) .layout,body:has(.scene-panel) .layout{display:block;margin-top:14px}
body:has(.zone-grid) #voiceState,body:has(.scene-panel) #voiceState{display:none}
body:has(.zone-grid) footer{display:none}
body:has(.scene-panel) .hero{min-height:180px}
body:has(.scene-panel) .hero-body{min-height:180px;padding:20px 35px}
body:has(.scene-panel) .hero h1{font-size:clamp(32px,3.5vw,48px);margin:5px 0}
body:has(.scene-panel) .hero p{font-size:15px}
body:has(.scene-panel) .tags{display:none}
/* Scene: location art is visible behind all genuinely interactive targets. */
.immersive-scene{position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-height:740px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:25px;border:1px solid #74ddf6a9;
 background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(3,11,32,.28),rgba(4,11,33,.52) 58%,rgba(3,10,29,.75)),var(--world-scene)!important;
 background-size:cover,cover!important;background-position:center center,center center!important;
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #aeecff37,inset 0 0 125px #07112675,0 26px 70px #0009;
 padding:clamp(15px,2vw,27px)}
.immersive-scene::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;z-index:0;
 background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 13% 5%,#62e9ff3c,transparent 37%),radial-gradient(ellipse at 91% 79%,#f4ae6a28,transparent 30%);
 animation:ambientDrift 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate}
.immersive-scene::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-10%;z-index:0;pointer-events:none;opacity:.19;
 background-image:radial-gradient(circle,#e8fbff 1.1px,transparent 2px),radial-gradient(circle,#81f9ff 1.4px,transparent 2.5px);
 background-size:150px 120px,241px 177px;animation:sceneParticles 35s linear infinite}
@keyframes sceneParticles{to{transform:translate3d(-55px,-65px,0)}}
@keyframes ambientDrift{to{opacity:.55;transform:translate3d(1%,0,0)}}
.immersive-scene>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.immersive-scene .mech-head,.immersive-scene .game-top{
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(3,21,50,.91),rgba(7,27,62,.72));border:1px solid #7fdcff87;
 padding:12px 18px;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 #dbffff32,0 8px 25px #0005}
.immersive-scene .mech-head h2{font-size:clamp(24px,2.5vw,34px);margin:3px 0 0;letter-spacing:-.6px;text-shadow:0 3px 15px #010a24}
.immersive-scene .mech-head p{font-size:12px;color:#c8f0f7;margin:4px 0;max-width:80ch;line-height:1.35}
.immersive-scene .eyebrow{color:#92f4ff;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.5px}
.immersive-scene .mech-step,.immersive-scene .chip{border:1px solid #9befff75;background:#071e45d9;box-shadow:inset 0 0 18px #43deff12}
.immersive-scene .stepdots{align-items:center}
.immersive-scene .game h2,.immersive-scene h2{letter-spacing:-.6px}
.immersive-scene .game-top{margin-bottom:16px}
/* Tiny in-world comms, replacing the persistent sidebar. */
.scene-comms{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;max-width:590px;min-height:70px;margin:13px 0 12px;
 border:1px solid #79e7ff7a;border-left:4px solid #75ecff;border-radius:17px;padding:9px 11px;
 background:linear-gradient(100deg,#071d3fe8,#12294ce0);box-shadow:0 10px 28px #0008,inset 0 1px 0 #c0ffff24}
.scene-comms img{width:54px;height:54px;flex-shrink:0;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid #73fbf0;border-radius:50%;box-shadow:0 0 16px #5efbe080}
.scene-comms .comms-copy{flex:1;min-width:0}
.scene-comms .comms-label{font-size:10px;color:#84f4ed;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:1.2px}
.scene-comms p{font-size:14px;margin:3px 0;line-height:1.3;max-width:65ch;color:#f0fbff;font-weight:730}
.scene-comms button{min-width:54px;min-height:50px;border:1px solid #a8ffffa0;border-radius:13px;
 background:linear-gradient(145deg,#4cf0f7,#76b8ff);color:#07344f;box-shadow:0 4px 0 #20547f;font-size:25px}
.scene-comms button:active{transform:translateY(3px);box-shadow:none}
/* Content lives over the illustration, in legible holographic glass. */
.immersive-scene .mech-intro,.immersive-scene .listenrow{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#061936dc,#09234cce);border:1px solid #82cfe494;
 box-shadow:0 13px 28px #0009,inset 0 1px 0 #d0fcff1c;border-radius:18px;margin:14px 0;padding:14px}
.immersive-scene .mech-narration strong,.immersive-scene .mech-narration b{font-size:clamp(20px,2.4vw,27px);text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000}
.immersive-scene .mech-narration span,.immersive-scene .mech-narration small{font-size:13px;line-height:1.35;color:#c1f0f6}
.immersive-scene .mech-card{background:linear-gradient(165deg,#c6faff,#eeedff);border:3px solid #9dfaff;padding:7px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #fff7,0 0 0 3px #1173aa62,0 11px 26px #000a;color:#19385b}
.immersive-scene .mech-card img{background:#f8fdff;border-radius:10px}
.immersive-scene .mech-card b{font-size:22px}
.immersive-scene .mech-card small{font-size:12px}
.immersive-scene .mech-helpbar,.immersive-scene .hints{background:#041936cc;border:1px solid #8dd9f955;border-radius:16px;padding:9px;gap:8px;margin:13px 0}
.immersive-scene .hint{background:linear-gradient(#213d68,#142647);border-color:#86dfff71;font-size:13px;padding:11px 13px}
.immersive-scene .feedback{background:#041a34e9;border:1px solid #69dfff75;box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px #0fe5ff0e;line-height:1.4}
.immersive-scene .feedback.good{background:#10504acf}.immersive-scene .feedback.try{background:#512a39e3}
.immersive-scene .assist{background:#061b3de8;border:1px solid #93c9ed90}
.immersive-scene .audio-btn{box-shadow:0 5px 0 #235e8b,0 0 18px #65eefa38;border-radius:13px;min-height:52px}
.immersive-scene .audio-btn:hover,.scene-comms button:hover{filter:brightness(1.1)}
.immersive-scene .answer-grid.picture-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px;max-width:900px;margin:18px auto}
.immersive-scene .answer.picture,.immersive-scene .interview-pick{
 background:linear-gradient(145deg,#153a66d9,#253d72d9);border:2px solid #7eeafa9e;
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #b9f3ff36,inset 0 -35px 45px #051b3d38,0 10px 22px #0009;
 transition:transform .2s,filter .2s,box-shadow .2s;border-radius:22px}
.immersive-scene .answer.picture:hover,.immersive-scene .interview-pick:hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #efffff80,0 0 0 2px #6fe9ff,0 19px 30px #000a}
.immersive-scene .answer.picture img,.immersive-scene .interview-pick img{border:2px solid #d8f5ff;border-radius:13px;
 background:#f7fbff;box-shadow:0 5px 16px #0005}
.immersive-scene .answer.picture img{height:160px;max-height:22vh;min-height:112px}
.immersive-scene .word-chip,.immersive-scene .mech-tile{
 border:2px solid #d1faff;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#e5fdff,#95d7f7);color:#11345b;
 border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 6px 0 #457caa,0 10px 18px #0005;font-weight:900}
.immersive-scene .word-chip:focus-visible,.immersive-scene .mech-tile:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #f2cf5e}
/* The active environments reuse each planet's cinematic art and create world motion. */
.immersive-scene .beam-arena{height:410px;max-height:55vh;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#07204738,#17155288),var(--world-scene);background-size:cover;background-position:center;
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 65px #090922aa,0 13px 30px #0007;border-color:#85dbff90}
.immersive-scene .beam-arena::before{opacity:.38;animation:sceneParticles 30s linear infinite}
.immersive-scene .crystal{border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#4de4f8c8,#6346cde9);box-shadow:inset 0 0 28px #c6ffff66,0 0 30px #38f7ff6e;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.immersive-scene .crystal:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.025);box-shadow:inset 0 0 32px #fff8,0 0 42px #85eaff}
.immersive-scene .drone-map{height:470px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#071c2b74,#00323410),var(--world-scene);background-size:cover;background-position:center;border-color:#80e9f68a}
.immersive-scene .reactor-scene{background:linear-gradient(100deg,#071a39a3,#1126538d),var(--world-scene);background-position:center;background-size:cover;box-shadow:inset 0 0 45px #05152ebc}
.immersive-scene .rail-world{background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0a1d448c,#11244a80),var(--world-scene);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.immersive-scene .bridge-world{height:315px;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#0e1b4888,#18144363),var(--world-scene);background-position:center;background-size:cover}
.immersive-scene .transmission{background:linear-gradient(140deg,#071831f0,#132950e8);box-shadow:0 12px 25px #0007}
.immersive-scene .reader-line{background:#163c67bb;border-color:#91e8ff70;line-height:1.55}
.immersive-scene .interview-builder,.immersive-scene .reactor-slots{background:#071a40db;border:2px solid #8cedf5a3;box-shadow:inset 0 0 20px #54ddff20}
.immersive-scene .cargo-bin,.immersive-scene .mech-choice,.immersive-scene .reason-panel{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#122f5eeb,#213f7bd4);box-shadow:0 8px 23px #0007,inset 0 1px 0 #dcfbff23}
.immersive-scene .flight-area{height:440px;max-height:57vh;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#04173345,#11255563),var(--world-scene);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
/* Hub: fewer peripheral words, more time looking at the worlds. */
.sectiontitle small{max-width:40ch;line-height:1.35;font-size:12px}
body:has(.zone-grid) .sectiontitle small{display:none}
body:has(.zone-grid) .hero{min-height:250px}
body:has(.zone-grid) .hero-body{min-height:250px;padding:30px 42px}
body:has(.zone-grid) .hero h1{font-size:clamp(37px,4vw,54px);margin:6px 0 11px}
body:has(.zone-grid) .hero p{font-size:16px;max-width:52ch}
body:has(.zone-grid) .tags{margin-top:12px}.tag{font-size:11px}
/* General touch targets, reduced motion and mobile. */
button{min-height:44px}.answer,.crystal,.cargo-bin,.reason-panel,.mech-choice{touch-action:manipulation}
@media(max-width:1080px){.zone-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.zone-card.finale{grid-column:1/-1}}
@media(max-width:800px){.shell{padding:8px 10px 24px}.immersive-scene{padding:12px;min-height:650px}.scene-comms{max-width:none}.immersive-scene .mech-head,.immersive-scene .game-top{padding:10px 12px}.immersive-scene .drone-map{height:370px}.immersive-scene .beam-arena{height:320px}}
@media(max-width:620px){
 .topbar{padding:8px}.brand span{font-size:16px}.brand small{display:none}.navbits{gap:5px}.topbtn{font-size:12px;padding:7px 8px}.navbits .chip{font-size:12px;padding:8px}
 .zone-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.zone-card{min-height:190px}.zone-card.finale{min-height:190px}
 .hero{min-height:185px}.hero-body{min-height:185px;padding:19px}
 .scene-comms img{width:43px;height:43px}.scene-comms{gap:8px;padding:7px}.scene-comms p{font-size:12px}.scene-comms button{min-width:45px;min-height:44px;font-size:20px}
 .immersive-scene{min-height:560px;border-radius:15px}.immersive-scene .mech-head h2{font-size:22px}.immersive-scene .mech-head p{font-size:11px}
 .immersive-scene .mech-narration span,.immersive-scene .mech-narration small{font-size:12px}
 .immersive-scene .mech-intro{padding:9px;gap:8px}.immersive-scene .mech-card{max-width:35%;min-width:90px}.immersive-scene .mech-card img{height:90px}
 .immersive-scene .beam-arena{height:285px}.immersive-scene .drone-map{height:320px}.immersive-scene .bridge-world{height:250px}
 .immersive-scene .answer-grid.picture-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
 .immersive-scene .answer.picture{min-height:140px;padding:9px}.immersive-scene .answer.picture img{height:95px;min-height:0}
 .immersive-scene .game h2{font-size:25px}.immersive-scene .explain{font-size:13px}
 .immersive-scene .mech-helpbar,.immersive-scene .hints{gap:6px}.immersive-scene .hint{font-size:12px;padding:8px 9px}
 .immersive-scene .flight-area{height:310px}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.hero::before,.immersive-scene::before,.immersive-scene::after,.immersive-scene .beam-arena::before{animation:none!important}}

/* A navigable holographic star-map hub rather than a stack of dashboard tiles. */
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-grid{position:relative;isolation:isolate;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;
 padding:50px 20px 24px;border-radius:28px;border:1px solid #72ccfa8c;
 background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#030d2bd8,#09274a8a,#130a32bf),var(--map-scene);
 background-size:cover;background-position:center;box-shadow:inset 0 0 95px #000a,0 16px 50px #0008}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-grid::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:7%;right:7%;top:160px;height:4px;z-index:0;
 background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent,#6aecffbd,#dd91ff,#ffcc78,transparent);filter:drop-shadow(0 0 10px #4df3ff)}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale){height:auto;min-height:0;aspect-ratio:1/1;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid #83e7f6;
 padding:32px 9px 22px;align-items:center;justify-content:flex-end;text-align:center;
 box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 5px #d8ffff24,inset 0 0 42px #0ce0ff37,0 0 0 6px #4cc7ff26,0 8px 40px #000c;}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale)::before{border-radius:50%;filter:brightness(.81) saturate(1.3)}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale)::after{border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(0deg,#06132deb,#071533a8 42%,#06102a08 85%)}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale).locked{filter:grayscale(.32);opacity:.8}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale):hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.035);box-shadow:0 0 0 5px #4de4ff65,0 0 60px #5cfaff63}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) .zone-n{left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);top:12px;white-space:nowrap}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) h3{font-size:clamp(15px,1.65vw,22px);line-height:1.08;max-width:95%}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) p{display:none}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) .status{font-size:10px;margin-top:8px;max-width:95%;color:#fff0a4;line-height:1.2}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card.finale{grid-column:1/-1;border:2px solid #95f5fbaf;min-height:210px;border-radius:20px;margin-top:28px;
 background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,#072f56a8,#0f0a39b8),var(--map-scene);background-size:cover;background-position:center}
body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card.finale h3{font-size:clamp(25px,3vw,35px)}
@media(max-width:1120px){body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-grid::before{display:none}}
@media(max-width:620px){body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));padding:24px 10px 16px;gap:14px}
 body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale){min-height:0;padding:30px 5px 16px}
 body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) h3{font-size:16px}
 body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card:not(.finale) .status{font-size:9px}
 body:has(.zone-grid) .zone-card.finale{margin-top:9px;min-height:170px}}

/* Allen Mobile Offline: safe areas and child-friendly touch ergonomics */
html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%;scroll-padding-top:12px}
body{-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;overscroll-behavior-y:contain}
button{-webkit-user-select:none;user-select:none;touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #ffde7d;outline-offset:2px}
.shell{padding-left:max(11px,env(safe-area-inset-left));padding-right:max(11px,env(safe-area-inset-right));padding-bottom:calc(22px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom))}
.topbar{gap:10px}.navbits{gap:6px}
.audio-btn,#sceneReplay,#zigReplay,.topbtn,.action,.hint,.dpad,.controlbar button{min-height:48px}
.wild-target,.crystal,.word-chip,.cargo-bin,.vocab-card{touch-action:manipulation}
.drone-map,.beam-arena,.ship-arena{touch-action:pan-y}
@media(max-width:700px){
  body{font-size:16px}
  .shell{padding-top:max(8px,env(safe-area-inset-top))}
  .topbar{border-radius:17px;padding:8px 9px}
  .brand small{display:none}
  .navbits .chip{padding:7px 9px;font-size:12px}
  .hero{margin-top:9px}
  .game h2{font-size:clamp(20px,5.5vw,28px)}
  .game .explain{font-size:14px;line-height:1.35}
  .game-top .chip{font-size:12px;padding:6px 10px}
  .answer-grid{gap:10px}
  .answer.picture{min-height:155px;padding:10px 6px}
  .answer img{height:100px;max-width:100%}
  .listenrow{gap:9px;padding:10px}
  .listenrow strong{font-size:clamp(19px,5.3vw,25px)}
  .audio-btn{min-width:113px;padding:11px}
  .hints{gap:7px}.hints .hint{flex:1 1 42%;padding:10px 7px}
  .mech-shell{padding:12px!important}
  .controlbar{gap:7px}.dpad{min-width:50px;min-height:52px}
  .word-chip{font-size:16px;padding:10px}
  .vocab-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .mission-row{gap:9px}
  .mission{padding:16px 13px}
  .ship-hud,.game-top{gap:5px}
}
@media(max-width:380px){.audio-btn{min-width:105px}.hints .hint{font-size:13px}.answer.picture{min-height:145px}.answer img{height:86px}.hero h1{font-size:25px}}
@media(orientation:landscape) and (max-height:540px){.hero{min-height:140px}.hero-body{min-height:125px;padding:12px}.hero h1{font-size:25px}.shell{padding-top:5px}.game{padding:13px}}
